spans.s: अरे ind. An interjection- (1) of calling (used in addressing a person inferior in position), e.g. न वा अरे पत्युः कामायास्याः पतिः प्रितो भवति (said by Yājnyavalkya to his wife); (2) of anger; (3) of envy.
अरेरे ind. An interjection- (1) of calling to inferiors, अरेरे राधागर्भभारभूत सूतापसद किमेवमाक्षिपति Ve.iii.; (2) of calling angrily, अरेरे वाचाट Ve.iii.
